message.content: Elara finds unwinding after intense battles by engaging in less aggressive activities. She prefers to continue exploring the game world, collecting items, or undertaking side quests. This method allows her to relax and reset, readying herself to immerse back into the game's action whenever needed. Additionally, Elara enjoys leveling up her characters and experimenting with various party combinations, which can be both a strategic and relaxing activity, further detaching from the high-stress combat scenarios she might have just experienced.
